hardwareHubs.note: Wichita State's National Institute for Aviation Research provides prototyping, testing and advanced manufacturing services to the aviation and manufacturing industries.

programs.name: National Institute for Aviation Research (NIAR), Wichita State University
programs.note: Lists engineering, certification and prototyping, test and evaluation, and training in additive manufacturing and CAD/CAM.

specialties.name: Aviation and aerospace
specialties.note: NIAR states its mission includes supporting the aviation and manufacturing industries.

support.name: Kansas Manufacturing Solutions (KMS)
support.note: NIST lists it as the Kansas MEP center, offering continuous improvement, workforce, quality and smart manufacturing help from an office in Shawnee.
